```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(yaml)
```

## FEV data

```{r read-fev}
fn <- "../data/fev.csv"
read_csv(
  fn, 
  col_names=FALSE,
  col_types="nnncc") %>%
  data.frame -> pulmonary
names(pulmonary) <- c(
  "age",
  "fev",
  "height",
  "sex",
  "smoker")
glimpse(pulmonary)
```

## Creating an indicator variable

```{r}
#| label: 07-01-fev-1

pulmonary |>
	select(fev, sex) |>
	mutate(sex_male=as.numeric(sex=="M")) -> pulmonary1
```


```{r}
#| label: fev-2

pulmonary1 |>
	ggplot() + 
	aes(sex_male, fev) +
  geom_point(shape=1, size=2) +
	  geom_smooth(
	  	method="lm", 
	  	se=FALSE) +
	  ggtitle("Plot drawn by Steve Simon on 2024-09-27") +
	  xlab("Indicator variable for sex=M") +
	  ylab("Forced expiratory volume (liters)")
```




```{r save}
save(
	pulmonary,
	pulmonary1,
	file="../data/module07.RData")
```
